verdict.rationale: Snowflake's COPY INTO/Snowpipe mechanism for loading staged cloud-storage files is referenced (streams doc mentions 'inserts (including COPY INTO)', Snowpipe doc describes micro-batch loading from a stage) and corroborated by a community post confirming COPY skips already-loaded JSON Lines files, but the evidence pack never cites the actual COPY INTO command reference or a doc page explicitly confirming CSV, JSON, and Parquet support in one command from cloud storage. Missing for 10: direct COPY INTO syntax/reference docs, explicit multi-format (CSV+JSON+Parquet) confirmation, and independent hands-on validation covering all three formats.
